results.name: CPU and low-memory caps are conservative and malformed pool limits are rejected
lazy pool bounds parallelism, ignores wrong IDs and schedules queued jobs FIFO
completed workers are reused then actually terminated after idle
deadline kills a hung worker and a later queued job proceeds on a new worker
a deadline also removes a waiting job, even if the worker never answers
crash, unreadable reply and postMessage failure release capacity without losing subsequent jobs
worker startup failure is distinguished for fallback; partial capacity remains usable
cancellation removes queued work, terminates only its active worker, and does not cancel another job
queue limit and close settle every promise and never dispatch post-close work
